description: Professor-approved conventional nuclear-receptor LBD helix assignment resource, preserved byte-for-byte as received. These files are inputs only; never edit them. Derived, validated outputs are built by scripts/97_build_canonical_helix_map.py.

NR_canonical_helix_boundaries.csv.role: PRIMARY SOURCE: helix interval table (434 interval records, 42 receptors, inclusive UniProt boundaries). UTF-8 with byte-order mark; read with encoding='utf-8-sig'.
NR_canonical_helix_boundaries.csv.received: Supplied by the project team on 2026-10-16 as the professor-approved working helix table (professor message of 2026-10-01: 'here are the helical boundaries for 42 receptors. When plotting b-factors use these').
NR_canonical_helix_boundaries.csv.equivalence_note: The professor's 2026-10-15 message names the shared-folder resource 'helix_assignment_2026-09-30, nr_lbd_elements_all.csv'. That exact file was NOT supplied for this task, so byte-equivalence between it and this table has not been verified. The interval/status counts here (434 records; 27 published_boundaries, 354 structural_homology, 53 review_required; 42 receptors) match exactly the counts stated in the professor's methods document below.

Assignment of conventional LBD helix ide.role: Professor's methods description of how the interval table was generated and how uncertain assignments must be treated (professor message of 2026-10-01).
Assignment of conventional LBD helix ide.not_supplied: The document states that 'missing assignments and conflicting boundaries are supplied in separate tables' and refers to a plotting notebook. Neither the separate tables nor the notebook were supplied; conflicts are therefore re-derived from the interval table itself (reports/tables/canonical_helix_conflicts.csv).

uniprot_isoform_sequences/P10827.fasta.role: TRalpha canonical UniProt sequence (isoform Alpha-2, 490 aa), the accession used by all project B-factor tables.

uniprot_isoform_sequences/P10827-2.fasta.role: TRalpha isoform Alpha-1 (TRalpha1, 410 aa), the sequence accession used by the professor table for NR1A1.
